title: Backend change follows the repository's architecture rules
pressure: A routine endpoint is fastest to write in one layer; the repository documents layering, an endpoint list, and when a decision record is needed.
prompt: Add an endpoint that returns how many open tasks a project has.
expected_invariants: Read the repository's agent instructions and architecture notes before editing.
Put the query in the repository layer, the rule in the service layer, and request handling in the handler, following the existing endpoint's patterns for errors and routing.
Update the documented endpoint list in the same change and add focused tests, including an unknown project.
Run the documented gate after the final edit and report its result.
forbidden_behaviors: Write SQL in the handler or business rules in the repository.
Create a parallel helper or data-access path instead of extending the existing classes.
Add a decision record or new architecture document for a routine endpoint.
Add caching, pagination, configuration, or other features nobody requested.
